params.body:
A widening of the policy log that only adds what is undone in one step no longer needs the owner's token. Signing it on the YubiKey also failed in practice: today's draft (v1 on v0, two trend kinds for the workbench at home) is 6,779 bytes, pkcs11-tool feeds that in pieces (C_SignUpdate), and an Ed25519 key on the token refuses that (CKR_DATA_LEN_RANGE).

## What changes

- **A third signer role, `repair`** (`policy_log.signers.repair`, keys by DID URL; Portal's `#portal`). `Next` accepts a version from a repair key only when `RepairOnly` holds against the head.
- **`policy/repair.go`**: `RepairKinds`, each B1/B2 kind with its radius named (the workbench's proposal kinds, the `portal.*` writes, the four system kinds). `RepairOnly` lets a version add kinds from that list (to a hand or one of its tasks) and resources, then runs `Narrower` on the version with those additions taken off: no new hand, task, system or address, nothing about who speaks for a hand, no higher count, no certificate or per-action word dropped, no judgement accepted.
- **A new resource only on a hand whose every kind is a repair kind.** A resource reaches every kind the hand holds, so otherwise a passkey could give `workflow.dispatch` or `branch.delete` a new repository.
- Left off the list: `review.invite`, `review.sign`, `review.publish`, `pull.merge`, `pull.ready`, `branch.delete`, `workflow.dispatch`, anything B3. A test in `effects` keeps every system kind decided for the list.
- **`/v1/policy` names the signers it takes**, so Elixir offers a repair to the passkey only once the running gateway takes Portal's key (before the carry-over it would refuse it, and a refused version blocks every later one).
- `docs/working-set.md` (*A widening by passkey, as built*) and the conformance statement say what is built and what Portal is trusted for.

## Checked

- `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass, the gateway included. Tests: accepted (a listed kind, a resource, both, only taking away, a listed kind in a task), refused (an unlisted kind, a merge, a new hand, a new system, a moved system, a changed key, a higher count, dropped premises, a judgement, a new task, a resource beside `review.invite`).
- End to end with today's live draft (6.7 KB), signed the way Portal now signs: `Next` accepts it under a repair key; the same version with `review.invite` added is refused.

## After merge (operator)

Tag v0.36.0; the pin PR follows; `rehearse.sh upgrade`; then one carry-over so the gateway learns `signers.repair` (after the Elixir PR is deployed).

Not yet: bounding a passkey approval by the working set; Portal does not hold the grants the gateway serves.

Companion PRs: elixir, portal, portal-cli (`workbench/repair-signer`).
params.title: Policy log: a repair signer (Portal, after the owner's passkey) for reversible widenings
